ttm.note: Latest 10-Q filed on or before 2026-10-21 is Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30, filed 2026-08-06); Q3 (Sep 2026) not yet filed. TTM = FY2025 (53 weeks) + 26-week YTD - prior 26-week YTD; the TTM window runs 2025-06-29 to 2026-06-30 (367 days, about 52.4 weeks) because of the 53-week FY2025 and the 2026 YTD cutoff on Jun 30. Convertible: $1.5B 0.00% notes due 2031 issued 2026-05-21; included in debtNoncurrent at carrying; settlement is cash up to principal with excess in cash/shares at ONTO's election (so full principal is a cash claim, excess is a share/cash claim; if-converted did not exceed principal at Jun 30 per the 10-Q). Capped calls ($88.9M premium, ~3.9M shares, cap $509.06) are equity-classified hedges, not claims; they offset dilution up to the cap. 805K shares repurchased at $254.53 concurrent with the offering are already out of the share count. After period end: Rigaku 27% stake (~$710M cash) pending at Jun 30 and reported as closed in August 2026 (post-period; a pending cash outflow not reflected in this balance sheet). Operating leases: new Andover HQ lease (~$36.4M undiscounted, commencing 2027) not yet on balance sheet.

notes: Fiscal year ends the Saturday closest to Dec 31; FY2025 ended 2026-01-03 (53 weeks).
ONTO discloses no stock options; employee equity is RSUs/PRSUs (484K nonvested at Jan 3 2026, PRSUs counted at target, 0-200% payout range) plus ESPP (not quantified, not included).
